purpose: Strategic annotations for a growing subset of verified normalized actions. These values are judgements, not game facts, eligibility rules, or a generated route.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop after the quest is complete; it is a one-time early combat foundation, not a repeated training method.
candidates.reentry_condition: Do not re-enter; let the completed quest reward stand while the evaluator considers later unlocked actions.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop after the spirit-tree transport outcome is secured.
candidates.reentry_condition: Do not re-enter; revisit the Gnome Stronghold only when another eligible action makes it convenient.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop after the quest and gnome-glider transport outcome are complete.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter once 25 Agility is met and the action becomes eligible, especially when its transport supports nearby work.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop after Varlamore and quetzal transport are unlocked.
candidates.reentry_condition: Do not re-enter; use the resulting access when Varlamore activities become eligible.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop when the quest is complete and the Ghostspeak amulet is secured.
candidates.reentry_condition: Do not re-enter; its quest flag and amulet feed later ghost and Morytania dependencies.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop after the quest, Morytania route, and Wolfbane are secured.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter when one verified 50-essence preparation option is ready.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop after completion, retaining the blessed sickle and druid pouch.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter after both prerequisite quests and the silver-sickle preparation are complete.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop after Zanaris access and at least one Dramen staff are secured.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter at 31 Crafting and 36 Woodcutting with the listed tools prepared.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop after quest completion and Magic secateurs acquisition.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter when Lost City, Nature Spirit, core tools, and the account-specific three-material assignment are ready.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop after quest completion and its fixed rewards are secured.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter when all three skill gates and the verified preparation inventory are ready.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop exactly at the permanent 100-Kudos Bone Voyage threshold unless another named reward justifies continuing.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter after The Dig Site when a verified mix of Museum contributions can reach the remaining Kudos gap.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop once Fairy Godfather permission is recorded; actual ring use still requires a Dramen or Lunar staff unless the elite diary waives it.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter when its prerequisite quest chain and staff preparation are complete; afterward use fairy rings to reduce travel across other eligible actions.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop after Fossil Island access is unlocked; establish its individual loops separately when ready.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter when The Dig Site and 100 kudos make the action eligible, particularly before pursuing birdhouse or seaweed setups.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop after the loop is established; do not turn the setup itself into a long session.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter as a short recurring passive task when Fossil Island access, 25 Construction, and a suitable attention window are available.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop after the seaweed setup is established; harvests belong in the passive lane.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter as a short recurring passive task when Fossil Island, 23 Farming, and a seaweed spore are available.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop when the immediate reward, Firemaking, or supply objective has been met, or when repetition outweighs its current value.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter for a defined near-term objective at 50 Firemaking or above; avoid treating it as a mandatory default grind.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop when the current Fishing, food, or reward objective is met rather than committing to an open-ended session.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter at 35 Fishing or above when its rewards serve a concrete account need or offer a desired content change.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop after the immediate Hunter or reward goal, and switch if the current rumour loop stops being enjoyable or useful.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter after Varlamore access and 46 Hunter when a varied active task fits the account's next objective.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop when the identified GP commitment is funded or the short cash objective is reached.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter at 30 Agility only when it is a named way to meet a specific cash deadline, with travel and desert supplies prepared separately.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop once the permanent enchantment knowledge is recorded; making or spending individual pendants is a separate decision.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter after The Dig Site with a clean necklace when Digsite or Fossil Island transport will support nearby objectives.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop once the permanent Fossil Island destination is bound.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter after Bone Voyage with a charged pendant, especially before recurring Fossil Island work.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop after the route is unlocked and let later travel demand justify individual trips.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter when the balloon network, 60 Firemaking, and the three Magic logs are already available.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop after the management loop and Miscellania transport are unlocked; resource collection remains a separately observed passive decision.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter when its quest gates and one verified kingdom-work preparation path are naturally ready.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop after the player-confirmed collection and updated Kingdom observation; do not infer resources or elapsed production.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter only when the established Kingdom loop is player-marked ready and a short present-attention window is available.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop after the player-confirmed session; its experience result and next readiness remain observations rather than inferred outputs.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter only when the established loop is player-marked ready and the account can give it a brief active session.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop when the immediate Runecraft, rune, pearl, or variety objective is met instead of treating reward rolls as a mandatory grind.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter after Temple of the Eye at 27 Runecraft with a pickaxe when its mixed outputs serve a current need.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop when the current Farming or points objective is met; it should not displace better-aligned farming work by default.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter at 34 Farming with the required planting and watering tools when a specific Tithe reward is useful.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop when the chosen Smithing, coins, reputation, or reward target is met, or when the commission loop no longer fits the account's metal supply.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter after Sleeping Giants when available metal inputs and a bucket or ice gloves support a defined output need.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop immediately after buying the rune pouch; the arena is not scored as an open-ended activity.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter only after all four verified pizazz balances are already held and the pouch's inventory utility matters now.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop after Sailing access and its fixed entry rewards are secured; assess its separate activities against current goals.
candidates.reentry_condition: Do not re-enter; complete it when the account is ready to make Sailing available as an option.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop once the Skiff is purchased; do not treat the 15,000-coin cost as a universal early deadline.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter after Pandemonium at 15 Sailing only when the Skiff enables a desired Sailing activity or access goal.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop when the current bounty objective or desired activity change is met; assigned rewards remain variable.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter after Pandemonium at 30 Sailing when a bounty's variable outputs suit a current economic or variety need.

candidates.stop_condition: Stop when the current Sailing, salvage, or variety objective is met; no assumed loot target justifies open-ended repetition.
candidates.reentry_condition: Re-enter after Pandemonium at 15 Sailing with a salvaging hook and a capable boat when its variable outputs fit a current need.
